answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn, with the bond locked for a full epoch and slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Like a nebula that only forms stars from real mass, the system treats each bond as costly mass: creating thousands of fake identities would ripple costs across the attacker at once, while a lone island operator with one honest identity pays only once and keeps its bond. Duplicates are detected by linking behaviour and keys, so fakes lose money instead of gaining rewards.
